package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for business_validation_mixed_with_persistence_calls_in_handler: Handlers that start querying or writing before finishing request validation.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type User struct {
	ID    int `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name  string
	Email string
}

func registerHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, db *gorm.DB) {
	name := r.FormValue("name")
	email := r.FormValue("email")

	if len(name) < 2 {
		http.Error(w, "name too short", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var existing User
	if err := db.Where("email = ?", email).First(&existing).Error; err == nil {
		http.Error(w, "email already taken", http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}

	if !strings.Contains(email, "@") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid email format", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	if len(strings.TrimSpace(name)) == 0 {
		http.Error(w, "name required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	user := User{Name: name, Email: email}
	if err := db.Create(&user).Error; err != nil {
		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("create failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "user %d created", user.ID)
}
